description: Scan a niche you describe, right now (Pro). Returns a ranked, sourced slate of the stories people in that field are talking about, with source links, the outlets, and why it matters. For a ready-made briefing use niche_feed_read instead. Assistant access requires Pro. Poll niche_session_state with the returned session_id until status is cp1_awaiting_story; the slate is in `stories`.

idempotency_key.description: Optional stable key for retries of the same scan, so a retry reuses the original run.

niche.description: Niche / beat description (2-200 chars). Specific is better.

recency.description: Reporting window: 24h, week, month, quarter, or year. Pair with recency_strict for a hard cutoff.

recency_strict.description: Exclude reporting outside the requested window. Default false; strict windows can return fewer stories.

source_quality.description: strict prioritizes well-supported stories; balanced is the default; broad includes less-established reporting. Inspect the returned sources before relying on a claim.

thinking_budget.description: balanced returns a session_id immediately. fast waits briefly for stories and returns them if ready; otherwise poll niche_session_state.

name: niche_signal_scan
title: Discover stories (signal scan)
